# ADR 0002: Adapter per biller with its own bulkhead, timeouts and circuit breaker

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Bill payments aggregator

## Context

One slow biller must not exhaust resources for the others.

## Decision

Each biller adapter has a concurrency limit, timeouts sized to that biller, and a breaker.

## Consequences

Failures stay isolated. More configuration.

## Alternatives considered

Shared HTTP client settings for all billers.
